text:
Maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem earlier — the 11:32 serving regression looks like two overlapping canaries hitting cold KV-cache was the smoking gun. We need concrete remediation + tracking so this doesn't repeat.

Sam: good call. I'll own the auto-rollback watcher + controller. I'll put up a design doc and a prototype watcher that runs in staging first.

Leo: I'll take blast-radius and flag-scope changes. plan is server-side targeting (by tier + region) and a small migration to add blast_radius metadata.

Nora: i'll write a short canary-sizing playbook and add it to the runbook (examples for small/medium/large tiers). also will include verification steps for KV-cache warming.

Maya: to keep things actionable, listing follow-ups and owners below. please ack and update when you start work.

- FUP-001: Auto-rollback watcher + safe rollback controller — owner: Sam — due: 2024-07-02
- FUP-002: Server-side blast_radius + flag policy + migration + unit tests — owner: Leo — due: 2024-07-05
- FUP-003: Canary-sizing playbook + runbook entry + QA checklist for SRE dry-run — owner: Nora — due: 2024-06-28
- FUP-004: Canary SLA alerting + rollback hook integration for oncall alerts — owner: eng-sre — due: 2024-06-28

Sam: implementation notes:
- watcher evaluates rolling windows for p50/p95/p99 and error_rate, compares against policy thresholds
- controller must support idempotent rollbacks, cooldown window, and an audit event per action
- will include a simulated-trigger mode for the staging harness

Sample policy (sketch):
```
{
  "canary_pct": 3,
  "metrics": {"p99_ms": 700, "error_rate": 0.02},
  "window_secs": 180,
  "auto_rollback": true,
  "cooldown_secs": 60
}
```

Leo: agree on server-side. i'll add blast_radius to the flag schema and default to 0.5% for free-tier early canaries; will also add an admin override. need to check migration times for the flag service.

Nora: for the playbook i'll include steps: 1) run warmup traffic for KV, 2) validate p99 in staging for 30m, 3) run dry-run rollback, 4) confirm metrics and audit logs.

eng-sre: we'll add an alert that triggers when canary p99 spikes > threshold for 3/5 evaluation windows and wire that to the rollback webhook in staging. for prod we'll require human-in-the-loop for initial rollout (opt-in auto-rollback after 2 successful dry-runs).

deploy-bot: created ticket PLAT-5041 "canary safety + auto-rollback followups" assigned to Sam/Leo/Nora/eng-sre — https://redwood.internal/tickets/PLAT-5041

Maya: scheduling a 30-min sync next Tue 09:30 to review PRs and the staging dry-run checklist. @Sam @Leo @Nora please add PR links to PLAT-5041 and assign reviewers.

Sam: ack, i'll open the design PR today and include the watcher sim harness. tagging @eng-sre for integration tests.

Leo: ack, starting branch for blast_radius changes. will post migration plan in the ticket.

Nora: ack, uploading runbook draft to the ticket now.

Maya: thanks all — i'll treat the incident as closed once PLAT-5041 has PRs, tests, and the runbook checklist. Ops: please surface any prior canary-related spikes in the last 90 days so we can spot patterns. :eyes:
